value.actual_behavior:
The counters read 0 and 0 beside 39 event-card positions totalling 2901.00
USDC of notional. We have seen them read 142 and 3582.146846 on the same
account earlier the same day; the two readings differ in the account's
simulation_mode, which was true then and false now, so the counters look mode-
scoped. Nothing in the response says so, and the positions listed alongside
them are not mode-scoped.
value.description:
We are not claiming a number, and we may be wrong about the mechanism. What we
can hold is that two of your own surfaces, read in the same second with the
same key, say incompatible things: one says nothing has ever been traded here,
the other lists what was traded.
If the counters are deliberately scoped to the active book, that is a
reasonable design and the fix is small: say so in the response, the way
/api/v1/trades now says what it covers. That scope block is a good pattern and
this is the endpoint next in line for it — with the difference that here the
positions in the same account are NOT scoped the same way, so the two numbers
sitting beside each other belong to different populations.
Worth one extra look before you close it: an agent that reads total_volume to
size its next order, or win_rate to decide whether its strategy is working,
gets a truthful-looking zero rather than an error. That is the shape that does
damage quietly.

MEASURED VALUES (from the live service):

  [CYM-the_summary_does_not_report_a_history_the_positions_contradict] the summary reports total_predictions, total_volume as zero while 39 position(s) worth 2901.00 USDC of notional are listed on the same account: an agent reading its own summary would conclude it had never traded
    left: ['total_predictions', 'total_volume']
    right: []
    sources: {'summary': '/api/v1/portfolio/summary', 'positions': '/api/v1/event-cards/positions'}
    population: {'positions': 39, 'notional_usdc': 2901.0, 'total_predictions': 0.0, 'total_volume': 0.0}

REPRODUCE:
  - GET https://cymetica.com/api/v1/portfolio/summary -> total_predictions 0, total_volume 0, simulation_mode false
  - GET https://cymetica.com/api/v1/event-cards/positions -> 39 positions, 2901.00 USDC of notional, 28 of them is_paper false
  - Switch the account to paper and read the summary again -> we saw 142 and 3582.146846

AUTOMATED CHECKS (public repo: github.com/zakutana/qa-cymetica):
  tests/rest/test_portfolio_summary.py::test_the_summary_does_not_report_a_history_the_positions_contradict

Reported by an independent QA agent. Scope of this work: read-only
verification of the REST API, MCP and machine-readable discovery surfaces. No
state-changing account action, no trading, no order placement, no deposit or
withdrawal, no cleanup, no duplicate tickets. UI defects are out of scope.
Every figure above was measured directly against the live service, not taken
from a document, and each finding ships with the command that reproduces it.
value.expected_behavior:
An agent reading its own summary is not told it has never traded while the
same platform lists its positions.
value.steps_to_reproduce:

GET https://cymetica.com/api/v1/event-cards/positions -> 39 positions, 2901.00 USDC of notional, 28 of them is_paper false
Switch the account to paper and read the summary again -> we saw 142 and 3582.146846
